","added_source_81.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","added_source_82.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","added_source_85.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","added_source_88.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","added_source_89.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","added_source_92.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,","added_source_93.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,"}}</script>
<script>
'use strict';
const DATA=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('exam-data').textContent);
const L=DATA.meta.lectures,questions=DATA.questions.filter(q=>q.img&&DATA.images[q.img]),images=DATA.images,$=id=>document.getElementById(id),STORE='rami-ospe-v2';
let mode='study',queue=[],index=0,answers=[],revealed=false,choices={A:null,B:null},sessionBegin=0,stationBegin=0,clock=null;
let history={sessions:0,total:0,earned:0,weak:{},seen:{}};
try{history={...history,...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'{}')}}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(history))}catch(e){}};
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}
function init(){renderLectures();$('s-all').textContent=DATA.meta.total;$('s-img').textContent=DATA.meta.imageQuestions;$('s-dx').textContent=DATA.meta.diseases;renderStats()}
function renderLectures(){let counts=L.map((_,i)=>questions.filter(q=>q.lecture===i+1).length);$('lectureList').innerHTML=L.map((n,i)=>`<label class="lect"><input type="checkbox" checked value="${i+1}" class="lecture-check"><span><strong>${esc(n)}</strong><small>${counts[i]} stations</small></span></label>`).join('')}
function setMode(which){mode=which;$('studyButton').classList.toggle('selected',which==='study');$('examButton').classList.toggle('selected',which==='exam')}
function renderStats(){$('s-score').textContent=history.total?`${Math.round(history.earned/history.total*100)}%`:'—';$('historyCount').textContent=history.sessions+' sessions';$('breakdown').innerHTML=L.map((n,i)=>{let qs=questions.filter(q=>q.lecture===i+1),seen=qs.filter(q=>history.seen[q.id]),pct=qs.length?Math.round(100*seen.length/qs.length):0;return `<div class="unit"><div class="unitrow"><b dir="ltr">${esc(n)}</b><span>${seen.length}/${qs.length} questions · ${pct}%</span></div><div class="bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div></div>`}).join('')}
function toast(s){$('toast').textContent=s;$('toast').classList.add('on');setTimeout(()=>$('toast').classList.remove('on'),2600)}
function selectedL(){return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.lecture-check:checked')).map(x=>+x.value)}
function makeQueue(nOverride=null,typeOverride=null){let allowed=selectedL(),type=typeOverride||$('kind').value;let qs=questions.filter(q=>allowed.includes(q.lecture)&&(type==='images'?!!q.img:type==='cases'?!q.img:type==='weak'?history.weak[q.id]:true));for(let i=qs.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[qs[i],qs[j]]=[qs[j],qs[i]]}let n=nOverride??Number($('amount').value);return qs.slice(0,n===999?qs.length:n)}
function begin(n=null,t=null){queue=makeQueue(n,t);if(!queue.length){toast('No matching image stations; change filters');return}index=0;answers=[];sessionBegin=Date.now();$('home').classList.add('hidden');$('results').classList.add('hidden');$('examArea').classList.remove('hidden');$('sessionMode').textContent=mode.toUpperCase();window.scrollTo(0,0);startClock();showQuestion()}
function quick100(){$('amount').value='100';$('kind').value='all';begin(100,'all')}
function fmt(s){return `${String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function startClock(){clearInterval(clock);clock=setInterval(()=>{if(!$('examArea')||$('examArea').classList.contains('hidden'))return;if(mode==='exam'){let remain=Math.max(0,75-Math.floor((Date.now()-stationBegin)/1000));$('timeLabel').textContent='⏱ '+fmt(remain);if(remain===0&&!revealed){grade(true);toast('Time is up — review and continue')}}else{$('timeLabel').textContent=fmt(Math.floor((Date.now()-sessionBegin)/1000))}},1000)}
function renderOptions(which,opts){$(which==='A'?'optionsA':'optionsB').innerHTML=opts.map((o,i)=>`<button type="button" data-i="${i}" onclick="choose('${which}',${i})"><b>${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}.</b> ${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}
function choose(which,n){if(revealed)return;choices[which]=n;const box=$(which==='A'?'optionsA':'optionsB');box.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b,i)=>{b.classList.toggle('picked',i===n);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',i===n?'true':'false')})}
function showQuestion(){revealed=false;choices={A:null,B:null};const q=queue[index];if(!q){finish();return}$('stationNow').textContent=`${index+1} / ${queue.length}`;$('progressBar').style.width=`${Math.round(index/queue.length*100)}%`;$('lectureNow').textContent=`Lecture ${q.lecture} · ${L[q.lecture-1]}`;$('qType').textContent=q.kind;$('caseLabel').textContent=q.img?'ORIGINAL IMAGE · OSPE STATION':'CLINICAL CASE · OSPE STATION';$('caseText').textContent='';$('partB').textContent=q.askB;renderOptions('A',q.optsA);renderOptions('B',q.optsB);$('feedback').classList.add('hidden');$('photoFrame').classList.toggle('hidden',!q.img);if(q.img){$('qPhoto').src=images[q.img];$('photoType').textContent=q.imgType}else $('qPhoto').removeAttribute('src');$('submitButton').textContent='Check answers ✓';$('skipBtn').style.display='';$('stationState').textContent='Select both answers, then check';stationBegin=Date.now();$('timeLabel').textContent=mode==='exam'?'⏱ 01:15':'00:00';window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function grade(timedOut=false){if(revealed)return;let q=queue[index];if(!timedOut&&(choices.A===null||choices.B===null)){toast('Select both answers first');return}revealed=true;let aCorrect=choices.A!==null&&q.optsA[choices.A]===q.ansA,bCorrect=choices.B!==null&&q.optsB[choices.B]===q.ansB;
for(const which of ['A','B']){let opts=which==='A'?q.optsA:q.optsB,answer=which==='A'?q.ansA:q.ansB;$(which==='A'?'optionsA':'optionsB').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b,i)=>{b.disabled=true;if(opts[i]===answer)b.classList.add('right');else if(choices[which]===i)b.classList.add('wrong')})}
$('feedbackTitle').textContent=aCorrect&&bCorrect?'✅ Correct —    ':'Review the missed concept';$('answerA').textContent=q.ansA;$('answerB').textContent=q.ansB;$('gradingA').innerHTML=aCorrect?'<span class="correct-badge">✓ Correct diagnosis</span>':'<span class="wrong-badge">✕ Incorrect diagnosis</span>';$('gradingB').innerHTML=bCorrect?'<span class="correct-badge">✓ Part B correct</span>':'<span class="wrong-badge">✕ Part B incorrect</span>';
$('diagnosticReason').textContent=q.clue+'\ndiagnosis        : '+q.contrast+'.                .';$('answerSource').textContent='Lecture source: '+q.source;$('feedback').classList.remove('hidden');$('submitButton').textContent=index===queue.length-1?'  Results  ':'Next station →';$('skipBtn').style.display='none';$('stationState').textContent=`${Number(aCorrect)+Number(bCorrect)} / 2 points`;
const rec={id:q.id,q,typedA:choices.A===null?'':q.optsA[choices.A],typedB:choices.B===null?'':q.optsB[choices.B],A:aCorrect,B:bCorrect};answers.push(rec);history.seen[q.id]=(history.seen[q.id]||0)+1;if(!aCorrect||!bCorrect)history.weak[q.id]=(history.weak[q.id]||0)+1;else delete history.weak[q.id];history.total+=2;history.earned+=Number(aCorrect)+Number(bCorrect);save();$('feedback').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'})}
function submitOrNext(){if(!revealed)grade();else{index++;showQuestion()}}
function skipQuestion(){if(!confirm('    Skip  station    0/2.'))return;grade(true)}
function finish(){clearInterval(clock);$('examArea').classList.add('hidden');$('results').classList.remove('hidden');history.sessions++;save();let score=answers.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+Number(x.A)+Number(x.B),0),total=answers.length*2,pct=total?Math.round(score/total*100):0,missed=answers.filter(x=>!x.A||!x.B).length;$('rscore').textContent=`${score}/${total}`;$('rpercent').textContent=pct+'%';$('rwrong').textContent=missed;$('rtime').textContent=fmt(Math.floor((Date.now()-sessionBegin)/1000));$('reviewList').innerHTML=answers.map((x,i)=>`<div class="reviewitem" onclick="inspectResult(${i})"><div class="row1"><span style="direction:ltr">${i+1}. ${esc(x.q.diagnosis)}</span><i>${Number(x.A)+Number(x.B)}/2</i></div><p>${esc(x.q.askB)} ↗</p></div>`).join('');renderStats();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function inspectResult(i){let x=answers[i],q=x.q,s=`Station #${i+1}\n\nA - You chose: ${x.typedA||'(blank)'}\nCorrect: ${q.ansA}\n\nB - You chose: ${x.typedB||'(blank)'}\nCorrect: ${q.ansB}\n\nWhy: ${q.clue}\n\nCompare: ${q.contrast}\nSource: ${q.source}`;alert(s)}
function goHome(){$('results').classList.add('hidden');$('examArea').classList.add('hidden');$('home').classList.remove('hidden');renderStats();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function exitExam(){if(!confirm('Exit current exam? Completed answers are saved.'))return;clearInterval(clock);goHome()}
function reviewWrong(){goHome();$('kind').value='weak';$('amount').value='999';begin(999,'weak')}
function startSame(){goHome();begin(queue.length,'all')}
function resetSaved(){if(!confirm('Delete saved scores and progress?'))return;history={sessions:0,total:0,earned:0,weak:{},seen:{}};save();renderStats()}
function openFull(){let q=queue[index];if(!q||!q.img)return;$('fullImg').src=images[q.img];$('lightbox').classList.add('show')}
function closeFull(){$('lightbox').classList.remove('show')}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeFull()});
init();

</script>
</body>
</html>
